summary: The requirement document asks for a platform for a trucking company's dispatchers, drivers, fleet managers, accounts staff and customers. It covers trip planning, live truck tracking, a driver Android app that works offline, parcel scanning, proof of delivery, invoicing and Tally sync, with three years of support.

evidence.quote: Dispatchers and customers shall see trucks live on a map, with the expected arrival time at each stop.

stories: As a dispatcher, I can see trucks live on a map with the expected arrival time at each stop
As a customer, I can see my truck live on a map

evidence.quote: Drivers shall use an Android app to see their trips, start and finish each stop, and call the customer.

stories: As a driver, I can see my trips in the app
As a driver, I can start and finish each stop
As a driver, I can call the customer from the app

evidence.quote: Drivers shall scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery with the phone camera.

stories: As a driver, I can scan the barcode on every parcel at pickup and delivery

evidence.quote: The driver app shall keep working on highways without mobile network and send the data when the network returns.

stories: As a driver, I can keep using the app without network and have my data sent when the network returns

evidence.quote: Customers shall receive an SMS with a tracking link when their parcel is out for delivery.

stories: As a customer, I get an SMS with a tracking link when my parcel is out for delivery

evidence.quote: Trip expenses above ₹5,000 shall go to the fleet manager for approval.

stories: As a fleet manager, I can approve trip expenses above ₹5,000

evidence.quote: Accounts staff shall generate GST freight invoices for customers each month.

stories: As accounts staff, I can generate GST freight invoices for customers each month

evidence.quote: Invoices and payments shall be sent to Tally automatically every day.

stories: As accounts staff, I have invoices and payments sent to Tally automatically every day

evidence.quote: Fleet managers shall see reports of trips, delays, fuel cost per kilometre and on-time delivery.

stories: As a fleet manager, I can see reports of trips, delays, fuel cost per kilometre and on-time delivery

other_features.name: Trip planning and dispatch
other_features.description: Dispatchers create delivery trips, assign a truck and driver, and add stops in order.
stories: As a dispatcher, I can create a delivery trip, assign a truck and a driver, and add the stops in order

evidence.quote: Dispatchers shall create delivery trips, assign a truck and a driver, and add the stops in order.

other_features.name: Route order suggestion
other_features.description: The system suggests the best order of stops for a trip to reduce distance and time.
stories: As a dispatcher, I can get a suggested best order of stops for a trip

evidence.quote: The system shall suggest the best order of stops for a trip to reduce distance and time.

other_features.name: GPS tracker integration
other_features.description: Read each truck's location every minute from the tracker company's API.
stories: As a dispatcher, I can rely on truck locations being read every minute from the tracker company's API

evidence.quote: Every truck carries a GPS tracker; the platform shall read the trackers' locations every minute from the tracker company's API.

other_features.name: Proof of delivery capture
other_features.description: The driver captures the receiver's signature and a photo at delivery.
stories: As a driver, I can capture the receiver's signature and a photo as proof of delivery

evidence.quote: At delivery the driver shall capture the receiver's signature and a photo as proof of delivery.

other_features.name: Fuel and service tracking
other_features.description: Drivers enter fuel fills and repair costs; fleet managers see fuel use and service due dates per truck.
stories: As a driver, I can enter fuel fills and repair costs
As a fleet manager, I can see each truck's fuel use and service due dates

evidence.quote: Drivers shall enter fuel fills and repair costs; fleet managers shall see each truck's fuel use and service due dates.
Drivers shall use an Android app to see their trips, start and finish each stop, and call the customer.
The vendor shall support the platform for three years, including round-the-clock on-call support for the driver app.
